card.title: Don’t Be Difficult
card.instruction: Treat every request, correction, or small inconvenience as a warning that you are becoming too much trouble.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could I have another fork? Sorry, this one's bent.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Of course. I'll get one from the kitchen.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Please sit down. I shouldn't have made you get up during dinner.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm getting the pudding anyway. It isn't an extra trip.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then just bring pudding. I've already got a spoon. I'll save the peas for another time.
